verses.en: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
verses.pt: Naqueles dias, havendo de novo uma grande multidão, e não tendo o que comer, chamou Jesus os discípulos e disse-lhes:
verses.en_web: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself, and said to them,
verses.en_bbe: In those days again, when there was a great mass of people and they had no food, he made his disciples come to him and said to them,

verses.en: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
verses.pt: Tenho compaixão da multidão, porque já faz três dias que eles estão comigo, e não têm o que comer.
verses.en_web: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.
verses.en_bbe: I have pity for these people because they have been with me now three days, and have no food;

verses.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
verses.pt: Se eu os mandar em jejum para suas casas, desfalecerão no caminho; e alguns deles vieram de longe.
verses.en_web: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
verses.en_bbe: If I send them away to their houses with no food, they will be overcome by weariness on the way; and some of them have come from far.

verses.en: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
verses.pt: E seus discípulos lhe responderam: Donde poderá alguém satisfazê-los de pão aqui no deserto?
verses.en_web: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
verses.en_bbe: And his disciples said in answer, How will it be possible to get enough bread for these men here in a waste place?

verses.en: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhes Jesus: Quantos pães tendes? Responderam: Sete.
verses.en_web: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
verses.en_bbe: And he put the question, How much bread have you? And they said, Seven cakes.

verses.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
verses.pt: Logo mandou ao povo que se sentasse no chão; e tomando os sete pães e havendo dado graças, partiu-os e os entregava a seus discípulos para que os distribuíssem; e eles os distribuíram pela multidão.
verses.en_web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the people be seated on the earth: and he took the seven cakes and, having given praise, he gave the broken bread to his disciples to put before them; and they put it before the people.

verses.en: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
verses.pt: Tinham também alguns peixinhos, os quais ele abençoou, e mandou que estes também fossem distribuídos.
verses.en_web: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
verses.en_bbe: And they had some small fishes; and blessing them he had them put before the people in the same way.

verses.en: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
verses.pt: Comeram, pois, e se fartaram; e dos pedaços que sobejavam levantaram sete alcofas.
verses.en_web: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
verses.en_bbe: And they took the food, and had enough; and they took up seven baskets full of the broken bits.

verses.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
verses.pt: Ora, eram cerca de quatro mil homens. E Jesus os despediu.
verses.en_web: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
verses.en_bbe: And there were about four thousand people: and he sent them away.

verses.en: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.pt: E, entrando logo no barco com seus discípulos, foi para as regiões de Dalmanuta.
verses.en_web: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
verses.en_bbe: And he got into the boat with his disciples straight away, and came into the country of Dalmanutha.

verses.en: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
verses.pt: Saíram os fariseus e começaram a discutir com ele, pedindo-lhe um sinal do céu, para o experimentarem.
verses.en_web: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, and testing him.
verses.en_bbe: And the Pharisees came out and put questions to him, requesting from him a sign from heaven, testing him.

verses.en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
verses.pt: Ele, suspirando profundamente em seu espírito, disse: Por que pede esta geração um sinal? Em verdade vos digo que a esta geração não será dado sinal algum.
verses.en_web: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
verses.en_bbe: And he was very sad in spirit, and said, Why is this generation looking for a sign? truly, I say to you, No sign will be given to this generation.

verses.en: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
verses.pt: E, deixando-os, tornou a embarcar e foi para o outro lado.
verses.en_web: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
verses.en_bbe: And he went away from them, and again got into the boat and went across to the other side.

verses.en: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
verses.pt: Ora, eles se esqueceram de levar pão, e no barco não tinham consigo senão um pão.
verses.en_web: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
verses.en_bbe: And they had taken no thought to get bread; and they had only one cake of bread with them in the boat.

verses.en: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
verses.pt: E Jesus ordenou-lhes, dizendo: Olhai, guardai-vos do fermento dos fariseus e do fermento de Herodes.
verses.en_web: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Take care to be on the watch against the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.

verses.en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
verses.pt: Pelo que eles arrazoavam entre si porque não tinham pão.
verses.en_web: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to one another, We have no bread.

verses.en: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
verses.pt: E Jesus, percebendo isso, disse-lhes: Por que arrazoais por não terdes pão? não compreendeis ainda, nem entendeis? tendes o vosso coração endurecido?
verses.en_web: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, hearing it, said to them, Why are you reasoning among yourselves because you have no bread? do you still not see, and is it still not clear to you? are your hearts so hard?

verses.en: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
verses.pt: Tendo olhos, não vedes? e tendo ouvidos, não ouvis? e não vos lembrais?
verses.en_web: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
verses.en_bbe: Having eyes, do you not see? and having ears, have you no hearing? and have you no memory?

verses.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
verses.pt: Quando parti os cinco pães para os cinco mil, quantos cestos cheios de pedaços levantastes? Responderam-lhe: Doze.
verses.en_web: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
verses.en_bbe: When I made a division of the five cakes of bread among the five thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? They said to him, Twelve.

verses.en: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
verses.pt: E quando parti os sete para os quatro mil, quantas alcofas cheias de pedaços levantastes? Responderam-lhe: Sete.
verses.en_web: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the seven among the four thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? And they said to him, Seven.

verses.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: Não entendeis ainda?
verses.en_web: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Is it still not clear to you?

verses.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
verses.pt: Então chegaram a Betsaída. E trouxeram-lhe um cego, e rogaram-lhe que o tocasse.
verses.en_web: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to Beth-saida. And they took a blind man to him, requesting him to put his hands on him.

verses.en: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
verses.pt: Jesus, pois, tomou o cego pela mão, e o levou para fora da aldeia; e cuspindo-lhe nos olhos, e impondo-lhe as mãos, perguntou-lhe: Vês alguma coisa?
verses.en_web: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
verses.en_bbe: And he took the blind man by the hand, and went with him out of the town; and when he had put water from his mouth on his eyes, and put his hands on him, he said, Do you see anything?

verses.en: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
verses.pt: E, levantando ele os olhos, disse: Estou vendo os homens; porque como árvores os vejo andando.
verses.en_web: He looked up, and said, “I see men; for I see them like trees walking.”
verses.en_bbe: And looking up, he said, I see men; I see them like trees, walking.

verses.en: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
verses.pt: Então tornou a pôr-lhe as mãos sobre os olhos; e ele, olhando atentamente, ficou restabelecido, pois já via nitidamente todas as coisas.
verses.en_web: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
verses.en_bbe: Then again he put his hands on his eyes; and looking hard, he was able to see, and saw all things clearly.

verses.en: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
verses.pt: Depois o mandou para casa, dizendo: Mas não entres na aldeia.
verses.en_web: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
verses.en_bbe: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Do not even go into the town.

verses.en: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
verses.pt: E saiu Jesus com os seus discípulos para as aldeias de Cesaréia de Filipe, e no caminho interrogou os discípulos, dizendo: Quem dizem os homens que eu sou?
verses.en_web: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the little towns round Caesarea Philippi; and on the way he put a question to his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I am?

verses.en: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
verses.pt: Responderam-lhe eles: Uns dizem: João, o Batista; outros: Elias; e ainda outros: Algum dos profetas.
verses.en_web: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.”
verses.en_bbe: And they made answer, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.

verses.en: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
verses.pt: Então lhes perguntou: Mas vós, quem dizeis que eu sou? Respondendo, Pedro lhe disse: Tu és o Cristo.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, But who do you say I am? Peter said in answer, You are the Christ.

verses.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
verses.pt: E ordenou-lhes Jesus que a ninguém dissessem aquilo a respeito dele.
verses.en_web: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
verses.en_bbe: And he put them under orders not to say this of him to anyone.

verses.en: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.pt: Começou então a ensinar-lhes que era necessário que o Filho do homem padecesse muitas coisas, que fosse rejeitado pelos anciãos e principais sacerdotes e pelos escribas, que fosse morto, e que depois de três dias ressurgisse.
verses.en_web: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
verses.en_bbe: And teaching them, he said that the Son of man would have to undergo much, and be hated by those in authority, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be put to death, and after three days come back from the dead.

verses.en: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.pt: E isso dizia abertamente. Ao que Pedro, tomando-o à parte, começou a repreendê-lo.
verses.en_web: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said this openly. And Peter took him, and was protesting.

verses.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
verses.pt: Mas ele, virando-se olhando para seus discípulos, repreendeu a Pedro, dizendo: Para trás de mim, Satanás; porque não cuidas das coisas que são de Deus, mas sim das que são dos homens.
verses.en_web: But he, turning around, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
verses.en_bbe: But he, turning about, and seeing his disciples, said sharply to Peter, Get out of my way, Satan: for your mind is not on the things of God, but on the things of men.

verses.en: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.pt: E chamando a si a multidão com os discípulos, disse-lhes: Se alguém quer vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, tome a sua cruz, e siga-me.
verses.en_web: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.en_bbe: And turning to the mass of people with his disciples, he said to them, If any man has the desire to come after me, let him give up all other desires, and take up his cross and come after me.

verses.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
verses.pt: Pois quem quiser salvar a sua vida, perdê-la-á; mas quem perder a sua vida por amor de mim e do evangelho, salvá-la-á.
verses.en_web: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
verses.en_bbe: Whoever has a desire to keep his life, will have it taken from him; and whoever gives up his life because of me and the good news, will keep it.

verses.en: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
verses.pt: Pois que aproveita ao homem ganhar o mundo inteiro e perder a sua vida?
verses.en_web: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
verses.en_bbe: What profit has a man if he gets all the world with the loss of his life?

verses.en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.pt: Ou que diria o homem em troca da sua vida?
verses.en_web: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
verses.en_bbe: And what would a man give in exchange for his life?

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
verses.pt: Porquanto, qualquer que, entre esta geração adúltera e pecadora, se envergonhar de mim e das minhas palavras, também dele se envergonhará o Filho do homem quando vier na glória de seu Pai com os santos anjos.
verses.en_web: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him, when he comes in his Father’s glory, with the holy angels.”
verses.en_bbe: Whoever has a feeling of shame because of me and my words in this false and evil generation, the Son of man will have a feeling of shame because of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
